_comment: William 13:24: hair_test_v1 went too far — photographic, colour bled onto the armour, hair came out blonde/brown, crop at the thigh. Causes: heavy weights not bound to 'hair', 'flat color' in the negative (an anti-illustration term), 1girl/masterpiece/high-contrast tags. v2 = a gentle ladder from the sprite_samplers_v2 prompt that worked: only the hair phrase changes, the colour words sit inside the same parentheses as 'hair' (no bleed), weights 1.1-1.25; negative = v2's + brown/blonde/monotone hair (no 'flat color'). L5 = L3 as a Pre-Raphaelite painting. ArtUniverse only (the sprite winner), dpmpp_2m karras 28, four seeds.
